## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest correct change.

## Verification

- [ ] `make lint`
- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] Documentation and measured claims are updated where needed
- [ ] Logs, paths, prompts, and artifacts are sanitized

## Benchmark Evidence

If performance changes, include reproducible commands, model/runtime revisions,
sample sizes, and raw aggregate measurements. Mark projections and assumptions
explicitly.
